tests_changed_for_design.test: packages/runtime/test/credential-limits.test.ts 'a key at its usage limit (U-078) › the work waits until the reset, says so, and starts by itself then, after a restart too'
tests_changed_for_design.why: An ended session's badge and the log's end line now read 'Stopped to wait for a Claude credential' (and '...: nothing done. CHF 0.00.') instead of 'Waiting for a Claude credential', which stayed on the page after the credential was back (design §5 rule 4; ADR 0116 point 10).
More now lists Sessions first: ['Sessions', 'Plan', 'Docs', 'Reviews', 'Costs', 'Data'] (the owner's decision D2; ADR 0116 point 1).

new_problems: services/state-api/src/routes/sessions.ts calls sessionView without the ledger figure, so the state service (and the phone and approvals web through it) still shows a session's spend as the row's USD counter at today's rate; the extra argument is optional, so nothing broke, but the one-figure rule (ADR 0116) is not there yet. Phase H / the phone should pass sessionSpends' figure.

A planning session that waited for a Claude credential closes 'failed' (intake.ts finally), so its row reads 'Planning failed: Your Claude usage limit is reached. Try again once it resets.' while the project page says 'Planning waits …' (U-078). The row is true for that call but words a wait as a failure; d1109-cred-engine/C5 (which owns the intake's waitNow branch) could write handoff.planning.wait so planningGist says 'Planning waited for …'.

On the bench walk, the before-run planning session page showed 'CHF 0.00' because the row's counter was 0 while the ledger had booked the planning call; after the fix it reads 'less than CHF 0.01' (U-072 sibling, fixed by the one-figure rule).

A task a session worked on that ended neither done, failed, paused, needing you nor cancelled (stopped and put back to Ready, or sent back and left ready) reads 'Worked on' in 'Tasks in this session' (with 'now: …'): true but plain; the record has no 'stopped' list to word it better.

Design doc proposals (session lead's): §6 More list 'Sessions, Plan, Docs, Reviews, Costs, Data'; a new §3.11 'Project: Sessions' (job, shows, must not show, states) as ADR 0116 and runC-plan design_doc_changes[13] describe; §3.7 'Tasks in this session', 'All sessions', planning title and the two past-tense statuses; §3.4 'All N sessions'.
notes_for_other_areas: New module packages/runtime/src/daemon/session-list.ts (owned by d1109-sessions; later areas change only their named function): sessionGist(record), planningGist(facts), workingWords(store,row,tasks?) (calls projectStatusLine with cards [] and plan 'none' and a ProjectWorking built from the row's last task.started; d1109-run-visible C5 re-points it at runText), sessionEndWords(row, waits?), spentWords({chfMicro, kinds}, {working?}), startedByWords(row) (hands_off and continuation return null today with a comment: d1109-starts-engine C3 adds 'goes on with your session of 14:05' etc. there), countsWords(counts), resultTextNow(text, outcome, chfMicroNow), spentOf/sessionSpends (the one figure), sessionRecord/outcomeOfHandoff, durationOf, sessionRowView (one row; d1109-chat-recall can call it), projectSessionsView(store, projectId, {limit, before, chfPerUsd, blockedNow}) (d1109-onerepo-join adds the joined line here), sessionTasksView(store, sessionId), sessionsCursor/decodeSessionsCursor.
plan.startedBy is read as {by: 'person'|'schedule'|'hands_off'|'continuation', continues?: string} from the session row's plan JSON (startedByOf); d1109-starts-engine writes it.

New session-row handoff fields: handoff.outcome (LastSessionOutcome, runner end and recovery), handoff.last_worked_at (recovery's endDeadSession), handoff.planning ({failure?: string}, intake close and closeExpired). summary_cache.last_session is unchanged.

stop-words.ts: sessionStatusText now returns 'Stopped to wait for a Claude credential' (credential_wait) and 'Ended with a plan for you to approve' (plan_awaiting_approval); the session log's 'session.ended' line follows (event-lines.ts uses sessionStatusText). New planningStatusText(status). A later stop reason adds its words to this one map.

views.ts sessionView has a 6th optional argument extra: {spend?: SessionSpend; planning?: PlanningFacts}; statusText for a planning row is planningStatusText; SessionView.planning (optional) and ProjectSummary.sessionCount (optional) are new. recovery.ts: endedOutcome() builds the interrupted outcome used by both the row and recordLastSession.

New routes (DAEMON_ROUTES projectSessions, sessionTasks; client.projectSessions(projectId, {before, limit}), client.sessionTasks(id)); view types ProjectSessionRowView, ProjectSessionsView, SessionTaskView, SessionTasksView in api-types.ts. Fake daemon: state.projectSessions, state.projectSessionsChat, state.sessionTasks, working rows from state.sessions in the project status's working sentence. real-daemon describe 'd1109-sessions, run C' (append-only); its world() helper composes the role-player on a home on disk with per-title holds of model calls.

State: SessionRepo.pageForProject(projectId, {limit, before?: {createdAt,id}, ended?}), listedCountForProject(projectId); CostLedgerRepo.sumsBySessionAndSource(ids) -> {sessionId, sourceKind, usd_micro, chf_micro, entries}[], chatSpendForProject(projectId). No migration.

UI: PROJECT_TABS has 'sessions' first among the More tabs; SessionsTab.tsx exports sessionRowLine, sessionsHeading, NO_SESSIONS (d1109-onerepo-join renders its joined line there; d1109-run-visible changes the working row's expectation in sessions-tab.test.tsx). SessionPage: 'All sessions' link (data-testid all-sessions), planning title, 'Tasks in this session' (data-testid session-tasks). SummaryTab: 'All N sessions' (data-testid all-sessions). lib/time.ts durationWords.
